id-20261014-news-2.title: Nonsubsidized Fuel Prices and World Oil Above US$100: How Pertamina Determines Prices and the Impact on Citizens' Pockets

segments.src: Setiap awal bulan, banyak pengendara menunggu satu hal: apakah harga BBM nonsubsidi naik, turun, atau tetap.
segments.tr: Every beginning of the month, many drivers wait for one thing: whether non-subsidized fuel prices go up, down, or stay the same.

segments.src: Ketika harga minyak mentah dunia, termasuk Brent, bertahan di level tinggi, perhatian publik terhadap penyesuaian harga ini pun meningkat.
segments.tr: When world crude oil prices, including Brent, remain at high levels, public attention to this price adjustment also increases.

segments.src: Artikel ini menjelaskan secara ringkas bagaimana harga BBM ditentukan, apa bedanya BBM subsidi dan nonsubsidi, serta bagaimana perubahan harga bisa merambat ke ongkos transportasi dan harga barang.
segments.tr: This article briefly explains how fuel prices are determined, what the difference is between subsidized and non-subsidized fuel, and how price changes can ripple into transportation costs and goods prices.

segments.src: > Catatan: Artikel ini bersifat informasi umum dan edukasi, bukan nasihat keuangan. Angka harga dapat berubah sewaktu-waktu, sehingga selalu rujuk pengumuman resmi operator SPBU atau pemerintah.
segments.tr: > Note: This article is for general information and educational purposes, not financial advice. Price figures may change at any time, so always refer to official announcements from gas station operators or the government.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Harga Minyak Dunia Berpengaruh?
segments.tr: ## Why Do World Oil Prices Matter?

segments.src: Indonesia masih mengimpor sebagian kebutuhan minyak mentah dan BBM.
segments.tr: Indonesia still imports some of its crude oil and fuel needs.

segments.src: Karena itu, harga di pasar global menjadi salah satu acuan utama.
segments.tr: Therefore, prices in the global market become one of the main references.

segments.src: Brent adalah salah satu patokan harga minyak internasional yang paling banyak dirujuk.
segments.tr: Brent is one of the most widely referenced international oil price benchmarks.

segments.src: Ketika Brent naik dan bertahan tinggi, biaya pengadaan bahan baku BBM ikut meningkat.
segments.tr: When Brent rises and stays high, the cost of procuring fuel raw materials also increases.

segments.src: Selain harga minyak, faktor lain turut memengaruhi harga jual di SPBU, antara lain:
segments.tr: Apart from oil prices, other factors also influence selling prices at gas stations, including:

segments.src: - **Kurs rupiah terhadap dolar AS.** Pembelian minyak umumnya memakai dolar, sehingga pelemahan rupiah menambah beban biaya.
segments.tr: - **The exchange rate of the rupiah against the US dollar.** Oil purchases generally use dollars, so a weakening rupiah adds to the cost burden.

segments.src: - **Biaya pengolahan, distribusi, dan penyimpanan.**
segments.tr: - **Processing, distribution, and storage costs.**

segments.src: - **Pajak dan pungutan**, seperti pajak pertambahan nilai dan pajak bahan bakar kendaraan bermotor.
segments.tr: - **Taxes and levies**, such as value-added tax and motor vehicle fuel tax.

segments.src: - **Margin badan usaha** untuk operasional SPBU.
segments.tr: - **Business entity margins** for gas station operations.

segments.src: ## Bagaimana Pertamina Menetapkan Harga BBM Nonsubsidi?
segments.tr: ## How Does Pertamina Set Non-Subsidized Fuel Prices?

segments.src: BBM nonsubsidi, seperti Pertamax series, Dexlite, dan Pertamina Dex, harga jualnya mengikuti mekanisme pasar dalam batas ketentuan pemerintah.
segments.tr: Non-subsidized fuel, such as the Pertamax series, Dexlite, and Pertamina Dex, has its selling price follow market mechanisms within the limits of government provisions.

segments.src: Secara umum, harga dihitung dari beberapa komponen:
segments.tr: In general, prices are calculated from several components:

segments.src: 1. **Harga dasar**, yang mengacu pada indeks harga produk BBM di pasar internasional dan kurs.
segments.tr: 1. **Base price**, which refers to the price index of fuel products in the international market and exchange rates.

segments.src: 2. **Biaya distribusi dan operasional.**
segments.tr: 2. **Distribution and operational costs.**

segments.src: 3. **Pajak dan pungutan** sesuai peraturan.
segments.tr: 3. **Taxes and levies** according to regulations.

segments.src: 4. **Margin** badan usaha.
segments.tr: 4. **Business entity margins**.

segments.src: Pemerintah menetapkan formula batas atas harga eceran untuk jenis BBM tertentu, sehingga badan usaha dapat menyesuaikan harga secara berkala, umumnya sebulan sekali.
segments.tr: The government sets a retail price upper limit formula for certain types of fuel, allowing business entities to adjust prices periodically, generally once a month.

segments.src: Itulah sebabnya pengumuman harga biasanya muncul pada awal bulan.
segments.tr: That is why price announcements usually appear at the beginning of the month.

segments.src: ## Perbedaan BBM Subsidi dan Nonsubsidi
segments.tr: ## Differences Between Subsidized and Non-Subsidized Fuel

segments.src: | Aspek | BBM Subsidi / Penugasan | BBM Nonsubsidi |
segments.tr: | Aspect | Subsidized / Assignment Fuel | Non-Subsidized Fuel |

segments.src: | Penetapan harga | Ditetapkan pemerintah | Mengikuti formula dan kondisi pasar |
segments.tr: | Price setting | Determined by the government | Follows market formula and conditions |

segments.src: | Contoh | Pertalite, Biosolar | Pertamax series, Dexlite, Pertamina Dex |
segments.tr: | Examples | Pertalite, Biosolar | Pertamax series, Dexlite, Pertamina Dex |

segments.src: | Penyesuaian harga | Tidak otomatis, melalui keputusan pemerintah | Dapat berubah berkala |
segments.tr: | Price adjustment | Not automatic, through government decision | Can change periodically |

segments.src: | Sumber selisih biaya | Kompensasi/subsidi dari anggaran negara | Ditanggung harga jual |
segments.tr: | Cost difference source | Compensation/subsidy from the state budget | Borne by the selling price |

segments.src: Pada BBM subsidi atau penugasan, selisih antara harga keekonomian dan harga jual ditanggung melalui mekanisme subsidi dan kompensasi dari anggaran negara.
segments.tr: On subsidized or assignment fuel, the difference between the economic price and the selling price is borne through subsidy and compensation mechanisms from the state budget.

segments.src: Ketika harga minyak tinggi, beban anggaran ikut membesar.
segments.tr: When oil prices are high, the budget burden also grows.

segments.src: Inilah salah satu alasan pemerintah selalu mempertimbangkan keseimbangan antara daya beli masyarakat dan kesehatan fiskal.
segments.tr: This is one of the reasons the government always considers the balance between people's purchasing power and fiscal health.

segments.src: ## Efek Rambatan ke Ongkos Transportasi dan Harga Barang
segments.tr: ## Ripple Effects on Transportation Costs and Goods Prices

segments.src: Perubahan harga BBM, terutama bila berlangsung lama, dapat memberi efek berantai:
segments.tr: Fuel price changes, especially if they last a long time, can have a chain effect:

segments.src: - **Ongkos transportasi.** Biaya angkutan barang dan logistik bergantung pada bahan bakar, terutama solar. Kenaikan biaya ini dapat diteruskan ke tarif.
segments.tr: - **Transportation costs.** Freight and logistics transport costs depend on fuel, especially diesel. This cost increase can be passed on to tariffs.

segments.src: - **Harga barang kebutuhan.** Komoditas yang bergantung pada distribusi jarak jauh, seperti pangan segar, dapat terdampak biaya angkut.
segments.tr: - **Basic goods prices.** Commodities that rely on long-distance distribution, such as fresh food, can be affected by transport costs.

segments.src: - **Pengeluaran rumah tangga.** Pengguna kendaraan pribadi yang memakai BBM nonsubsidi akan merasakan langsung perubahan di SPBU.
segments.tr: - **Household expenditures.** Private vehicle users who use non-subsidized fuel will directly feel the changes at gas stations.

segments.src: - **Inflasi.** Kelompok transportasi dan energi menjadi salah satu komponen yang diamati dalam laporan inflasi.
segments.tr: - **Inflation.** The transportation and energy group is one of the components observed in inflation reports.

segments.src: Besarnya dampak tidak selalu sebanding.
segments.tr: The magnitude of the impact is not always proportional.

segments.src: Banyak faktor lain, seperti pasokan pangan, cuaca, dan kebijakan pemerintah, ikut menentukan harga di tingkat konsumen.
segments.tr: Many other factors, such as food supply, weather, and government policies, help determine prices at the consumer level.

segments.src: ## Tips Mengelola Pengeluaran Bahan Bakar
segments.tr: ## Tips for Managing Fuel Expenses

segments.src: - **Pantau pengumuman resmi** harga BBM tiap awal bulan agar bisa menyesuaikan anggaran.
segments.tr: - **Monitor official announcements** of fuel prices every beginning of the month to adjust your budget.

segments.src: - **Rencanakan perjalanan**: gabungkan beberapa keperluan dalam satu rute.
segments.tr: - **Plan trips**: combine several errands into one route.

segments.src: - **Rawat kendaraan**: tekanan ban yang tepat dan servis berkala membantu efisiensi.
segments.tr: - **Maintain your vehicle**: proper tire pressure and regular servicing help efficiency.

segments.src: - **Gunakan BBM sesuai spesifikasi** kendaraan, sebagaimana rekomendasi pabrikan.
segments.tr: - **Use fuel according to vehicle specifications**, as recommended by the manufacturer.

segments.src: - **Pertimbangkan transportasi umum** untuk perjalanan rutin bila tersedia.
segments.tr: - **Consider public transportation** for routine travel if available.

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Harga BBM nonsubsidi mencerminkan gabungan harga minyak dunia, kurs, biaya distribusi, pajak, dan margin.
segments.tr: Non-subsidized fuel prices reflect a combination of world oil prices, exchange rates, distribution costs, taxes, and margins.

segments.src: Sementara itu, BBM subsidi memiliki mekanisme berbeda karena melibatkan keputusan pemerintah dan dukungan anggaran.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, subsidized fuel has a different mechanism because it involves government decisions and budget support.

segments.src: Memahami cara kerja ini membantu masyarakat membaca berita harga energi secara lebih tenang dan menyiapkan anggaran rumah tangga dengan lebih bijak.
segments.tr: Understanding how this works helps the public read energy price news more calmly and prepare household budgets more wisely.

segments.src: *Informasi dalam artikel ini bersifat umum dan dapat berubah.
segments.tr: *Information in this article is general and subject to change.

segments.src: Untuk harga terkini, silakan merujuk ke sumber resmi.*
segments.tr: For the latest prices, please refer to official sources.*

id-20261014-news-3.title: Financial Inclusion Month October 2026: Access to Financial Services Widens, but Citizen Literacy Still Lags

segments.src: Setiap Oktober, Indonesia memperingati Bulan Inklusi Keuangan (BIK).
segments.tr: Every October, Indonesia commemorates Financial Inclusion Month (Bulan Inklusi Keuangan / BIK).

segments.src: Momentum ini biasanya diisi berbagai kegiatan edukasi, pembukaan rekening, hingga promosi layanan keuangan digital.
segments.tr: This momentum is usually filled with various educational activities, account openings, and digital financial service promotions.

segments.src: Namun di balik angka kepemilikan rekening dan pengguna dompet digital yang terus naik, ada pertanyaan penting: apakah masyarakat sudah benar-benar memahami produk yang mereka gunakan?
segments.tr: However, behind the continuously rising numbers of account ownership and digital wallet users, an important question remains: do people truly understand the products they are using?

segments.src: ## Akses naik, pemahaman belum selalu mengikuti
segments.tr: ## Access rises, understanding does not always follow

segments.src: Dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, akses ke layanan keuangan makin mudah.
segments.tr: In recent years, access to financial services has become increasingly easy.

segments.src: Membuka rekening bisa dilakukan lewat ponsel, pembayaran nontunai merambah warung dan pasar tradisional, dan produk asuransi mikro ditawarkan lewat aplikasi.
segments.tr: Opening an account can be done via mobile phones, cashless payments have spread to small shops and traditional markets, and microinsurance products are offered through applications.

segments.src: Survei Nasional Literasi dan Inklusi Keuangan (SNLIK) 2024 yang dirilis OJK bersama BPS mencatat indeks inklusi keuangan sekitar 75 persen, sementara indeks literasi keuangan sekitar 65 persen.
segments.tr: The 2024 National Financial Literacy and Inclusion Survey (SNLIK) released by OJK along with BPS noted a financial inclusion index of around 75 percent, while the financial literacy index was around 65 percent.

segments.src: Selisih sekitar sepuluh poin persentase itu menunjukkan bahwa jumlah orang yang *memakai* layanan keuangan lebih besar daripada jumlah orang yang *memahaminya*.
segments.tr: The gap of about ten percentage points shows that the number of people *using* financial services is larger than the number of people *understanding* them.

segments.src: Perbedaan ini penting.
segments.tr: This distinction is important.

segments.src: Inklusi berarti seseorang memiliki akses dan menggunakan produk keuangan.
segments.tr: Inclusion means a person has access to and uses financial products.

segments.src: Literasi berarti ia mengerti cara kerja, manfaat, biaya, dan risikonya.
segments.tr: Literacy means they understand how they work, their benefits, costs, and risks.

segments.src: Tanpa literasi, akses justru dapat membuka pintu bagi keputusan keliru.
segments.tr: Without literacy, access can actually open the door to mistaken decisions.

segments.src: ## Mengapa kesenjangan ini terjadi?
segments.tr: ## Why does this gap happen?

segments.src: Beberapa faktor yang kerap disebut para pengamat:
segments.tr: Several factors often mentioned by observers:

segments.src: - **Kemudahan yang melampaui edukasi.** Aplikasi dirancang agar cepat dan ringkas, sehingga pengguna sering menekan tombol "setuju" tanpa membaca syarat dan ketentuan.
segments.tr: - **Convenience that surpasses education.** Applications are designed to be fast and concise, so users often click the "agree" button without reading the terms and conditions.

segments.src: - **Informasi produk yang rumit.** Istilah seperti bunga efektif, premi, nilai tunai, atau biaya administrasi tidak selalu dipahami orang awam.
segments.tr: - **Complicated product information.** Terms like effective interest, premiums, cash value, or administrative fees are not always understood by laypeople.

segments.src: - **Kesenjangan wilayah dan usia.** Pemahaman cenderung lebih rendah di daerah yang jauh dari pusat kota, pada kelompok lansia, dan pada sebagian pekerja informal.
segments.tr: - **Regional and age gaps.** Understanding tends to be lower in areas far from city centers, among elderly groups, and among some informal workers.

segments.src: - **Kebiasaan mengikuti orang lain.** Banyak orang membeli produk karena rekomendasi teman atau tokoh di media sosial, bukan karena menilai kebutuhan sendiri.
segments.tr: - **The habit of following others.** Many people buy products because of recommendations from friends or figures on social media, rather than assessing their own needs.

segments.src: ## Risiko penipuan keuangan digital
segments.tr: ## Risks of digital financial fraud

segments.src: Kesenjangan literasi membuat sebagian warga lebih rentan terhadap penipuan.
segments.tr: The literacy gap makes some citizens more vulnerable to fraud.

segments.src: Modus yang umum dilaporkan antara lain:
segments.tr: Commonly reported modus operandi include:

segments.src: 1. **Phishing dan tautan palsu**: pesan yang mengaku dari bank atau dompet digital, lalu meminta pengguna membuka tautan dan memasukkan data.
segments.tr: 1. **Phishing and fake links**: messages claiming to be from a bank or digital wallet, then asking users to open a link and enter data.

segments.src: 2. **Permintaan kode OTP**: pelaku meminta kode verifikasi dengan dalih hadiah, pembaruan data, atau pemblokiran akun.
segments.tr: 2. **OTP code requests**: perpetrators asking for verification codes under the pretext of prizes, data updates, or account blocking.

segments.src: 3. **Penawaran investasi dengan imbal hasil tidak wajar**: janji keuntungan tinggi dan pasti dalam waktu singkat.
segments.tr: 3. **Investment offers with unnatural returns**: promises of high and certain profits in a short time.

segments.src: 4. **Pinjaman online ilegal**: aplikasi tanpa izin yang menarik data kontak dan menagih secara intimidatif.
segments.tr: 4. **Illegal online loans**: unlicensed applications that harvest contact data and collect with intimidation.

segments.src: 5. **Rekayasa sosial**: pelaku berpura-pura sebagai kerabat, petugas, atau layanan pelanggan untuk memancing transfer.
segments.tr: 5. **Social engineering**: perpetrators pretending to be relatives, officers, or customer service to lure transfers.

segments.src: Otoritas terkait terus mengimbau masyarakat untuk berhati-hati, dan layanan pengaduan resmi tersedia bagi korban atau pihak yang menemukan indikasi penipuan.
segments.tr: Related authorities continue to urge the public to be careful, and official complaint services are available for victims or parties finding indications of fraud.

segments.src: ## Langkah praktis bagi warga
segments.tr: ## Practical steps for citizens

segments.src: Meningkatkan literasi tidak harus rumit.
segments.tr: Improving literacy does not have to be complicated.

segments.src: Beberapa kebiasaan sederhana dapat membantu:
segments.tr: Several simple habits can help:

segments.src: - **Jangan pernah membagikan OTP, PIN, atau kata sandi** kepada siapa pun, termasuk yang mengaku petugas resmi.
segments.tr: - **Never share OTP, PINs, or passwords** with anyone, including those claiming to be official officers.

segments.src: - **Pastikan legalitas penyedia layanan.** Periksa apakah lembaga keuangan, platform pinjaman, atau perusahaan investasi terdaftar dan berizin di OJK melalui kanal resmi.
segments.tr: - **Ensure the legality of service providers.** Check whether the financial institution, loan platform, or investment company is registered and licensed with OJK through official channels.

segments.src: - **Hubungi layanan pelanggan lewat nomor atau aplikasi resmi**, bukan lewat tautan atau nomor dari pesan yang tidak dikenal.
segments.tr: - **Contact customer service through official numbers or applications**, not through links or numbers from unknown messages.

segments.src: - **Baca ringkasan produk** sebelum membeli: biaya, jangka waktu, risiko, dan apa yang terjadi bila Anda berhenti di tengah jalan.
segments.tr: - **Read product summaries** before purchasing: fees, time periods, risks, and what happens if you stop midway.

segments.src: - **Waspadai janji untung besar tanpa risiko.** Dalam keuangan, imbal hasil yang tinggi hampir selalu disertai risiko yang tinggi.
segments.tr: - **Beware of promises of big profits without risk.** In finance, high returns are almost always accompanied by high risks.

segments.src: - **Sesuaikan dengan kebutuhan.** Susun anggaran, dana darurat, dan prioritas sebelum memilih produk tabungan, asuransi, atau investasi.
segments.tr: - **Tailor to your needs.** Prepare a budget, emergency funds, and priorities before choosing savings, insurance, or investment products.

segments.src: - **Aktifkan notifikasi transaksi** agar aktivitas mencurigakan cepat terlihat.
segments.tr: - **Enable transaction notifications** so suspicious activity can be quickly spotted.

segments.src: - **Segera laporkan** ke penyedia layanan dan kanal pengaduan resmi bila terjadi transaksi yang tidak dikenali.
segments.tr: - **Immediately report** to service providers and official complaint channels if an unrecognized transaction occurs.

segments.src: ## Peran keluarga, sekolah, dan penyedia layanan
segments.tr: ## The role of families, schools, and service providers

segments.src: Literasi keuangan tidak hanya tanggung jawab individu.
segments.tr: Financial literacy is not just an individual responsibility.

segments.src: Keluarga dapat memulai dengan membiasakan anak mengelola uang saku dan menabung.
segments.tr: Families can start by getting children used to managing pocket money and saving.

segments.src: Sekolah dan kampus dapat memasukkan pengetahuan dasar keuangan ke dalam kegiatan belajar.
segments.tr: Schools and campuses can incorporate basic financial knowledge into learning activities.

segments.src: Sementara itu, penyedia layanan keuangan punya kewajiban menyajikan informasi dengan bahasa yang jelas, transparan soal biaya, dan menyediakan kanal bantuan yang mudah dijangkau.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, financial service providers have an obligation to present information in clear language, be transparent about fees, and provide easily accessible help channels.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Bulan Inklusi Keuangan sebaiknya tidak berhenti pada target jumlah rekening atau pengguna baru.
segments.tr: Financial Inclusion Month should not stop at targets for the number of accounts or new users.

segments.src: Ukuran keberhasilan yang lebih bermakna adalah seberapa banyak warga yang mampu mengambil keputusan keuangan dengan percaya diri dan terlindungi dari penipuan.
segments.tr: A more meaningful measure of success is how many citizens are able to make financial decisions with confidence and be protected from fraud.

segments.src: Akses adalah pintu masuk, sedangkan literasi adalah bekal agar perjalanan di dalamnya aman.
segments.tr: Access is the entrance, while literacy is the provision to make the journey inside safe.

segments.src: *Catatan: Artikel ini bersifat informasi umum dan bukan merupakan nasihat keuangan, investasi, atau hukum.
segments.tr: *Note: This article is for general information and does not constitute financial, investment, or legal advice.

segments.src: Untuk keputusan keuangan pribadi, rujuklah sumber resmi atau konsultasikan dengan pihak yang berwenang.*
segments.tr: For personal financial decisions, refer to official sources or consult with authorized parties.*

id-20261014-intro-logistics-11.title: [Logistics #11] Same Goods Price, So Why Can Import Bills Differ by Tens of Millions?

segments.src: > Tiga huruf dalam kontrak dagang — FOB, CIF, DDP — menentukan siapa bayar apa dan siapa menanggung risiko sampai barang tiba; sisanya diurus oleh dokumen dan Bea Cukai.
segments.tr: > Three letters in a trade contract — FOB, CIF, DDP — determine who pays for what and who bears the risk until the goods arrive; the rest is handled by documents and Customs.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Begitu barang menyeberangi batas negara, ada tiga lapis aturan yang harus kamu kuasai.
segments.tr: Once goods cross a national border, there are three layers of rules you need to master.

segments.src: Ini inti dari perdagangan internasional dalam rantai pasok.
segments.tr: This is the core of international trade in a supply chain.

segments.src: **1) Incoterms — pembagian tugas antara penjual dan pembeli**
segments.tr: **1) Incoterms — dividing tasks between seller and buyer**

segments.src: Incoterms (International Commercial Terms) diterbitkan oleh International Chamber of Commerce (ICC), versi terbaru adalah **Incoterms 2020**.
segments.tr: Incoterms (International Commercial Terms) are published by the International Chamber of Commerce (ICC); the latest version is **Incoterms 2020**.

segments.src: Isinya 11 istilah tiga huruf yang menjawab dua pertanyaan: *sampai titik mana penjual menanggung biaya?* dan *di titik mana risiko kerusakan/kehilangan berpindah ke pembeli?*
segments.tr: They consist of 11 three-letter terms that answer two questions: *up to which point does the seller bear costs?* and *at which point does the risk of damage or loss pass to the buyer?*

segments.src: Bayangkan sebuah tangga:
segments.tr: Picture a staircase:

segments.src: - **EXW** (Ex Works) — anak tangga paling bawah. Penjual cukup menyiapkan barang di pabriknya. Sisanya urusan pembeli.
segments.tr: - **EXW** (Ex Works) — the bottom step. The seller only prepares the goods at its factory. Everything else is the buyer's responsibility.

segments.src: - **FCA, FOB, CFR, CIF** — di tengah. Penjual mengantar sampai kapal/terminal di negara asal, sebagian juga membayar ongkos angkut dan asuransi.
segments.tr: - **FCA, FOB, CFR, CIF** — in the middle. The seller delivers to the ship or terminal in the origin country, and some also pay freight and insurance.

segments.src: - **DAP, DPU, DDP** — anak tangga paling atas. Penjual mengantar sampai alamat tujuan; pada DDP penjual bahkan membayar bea masuk dan pajak impor.
segments.tr: - **DAP, DPU, DDP** — the top step. The seller delivers to the destination address; under DDP the seller even pays import duties and import taxes.

segments.src: Tujuh istilah bisa dipakai untuk semua moda (EXW, FCA, CPT, CIP, DAP, DPU, DDP), sedangkan **empat istilah hanya untuk angkutan laut/perairan darat: FAS, FOB, CFR, CIF**.
segments.tr: Seven terms can be used for any mode of transport (EXW, FCA, CPT, CIP, DAP, DPU, DDP), while **four terms are only for sea and inland waterway transport: FAS, FOB, CFR, CIF**.

segments.src: Dua jebakan yang sering terjadi:
segments.tr: Two pitfalls that often happen:

segments.src: - **FOB dipakai untuk barang kontainer.** Pada FOB, risiko baru pindah saat barang *dimuat di atas kapal*. Padahal kontainer sudah diserahkan ke terminal beberapa hari sebelumnya — ada celah waktu tanpa kejelasan tanggung jawab. Untuk kontainer, ICC menyarankan **FCA** (atau CPT/CIP).
segments.tr: - **FOB is used for container cargo.** Under FOB, risk only passes when the goods are *loaded on board the vessel*. But containers are usually handed over to the terminal several days earlier, leaving a gap in time with unclear responsibility. For containers, ICC recommends **FCA** (or CPT/CIP).

segments.src: - **"CIF berarti penjual menanggung risiko di laut."** Salah. Pada CIF penjual *membelikan* asuransi, tapi risikonya sudah pindah ke pembeli sejak barang dimuat. Asuransi wajib minimalnya pun hanya kelas dasar (ICC klausul C).
segments.tr: - **"CIF means the seller bears the risk at sea."** Wrong. Under CIF the seller *buys* insurance, but risk has already passed to the buyer once the goods are loaded. The minimum required insurance is also only basic coverage (ICC Clause C).

segments.src: Yang **tidak** diatur Incoterms: cara dan waktu pembayaran, perpindahan hak milik, serta hukum mana yang berlaku bila sengketa.
segments.tr: What Incoterms do **not** govern: the method and timing of payment, the transfer of ownership, and which law applies if there is a dispute.

segments.src: Itu urusan kontrak jual beli.
segments.tr: Those are matters for the sales contract.

segments.src: **2) Kepabeanan — gerbang negara**
segments.tr: **2) Customs — the national gateway**

segments.src: Setiap barang punya **HS Code**, kode klasifikasi internasional yang di Indonesia dijabarkan dalam BTKI (Buku Tarif Kepabeanan Indonesia) hingga 8 digit.
segments.tr: Every product has an **HS Code**, an international classification code that in Indonesia is broken down into up to 8 digits in the BTKI (Indonesian Customs Tariff Book).

segments.src: Kode ini menentukan tarif bea masuk, apakah barang termasuk **lartas** (larangan/pembatasan) yang butuh izin instansi seperti Kemendag, BPOM, atau Kementan, dan apakah bisa dapat tarif preferensi lewat perjanjian dagang.
segments.tr: This code determines the import duty rate, whether the goods are subject to **lartas** (prohibitions or restrictions) requiring permits from agencies such as Kemendag, BPOM, or Kementan, and whether preferential rates can be obtained under trade agreements.

segments.src: Alurnya di Indonesia:
segments.tr: The process in Indonesia:

segments.src: - **Ekspor:** ajukan **PEB** (Pemberitahuan Ekspor Barang) lewat sistem CEISA → terbit **NPE** → barang boleh masuk kawasan pabean pelabuhan.
segments.tr: - **Export:** file a **PEB** (Export Goods Notification) through the CEISA system → an **NPE** is issued → goods may enter the port customs area.

segments.src: - **Impor:** ajukan **PIB** (Pemberitahuan Impor Barang), bayar bea masuk + PPN impor + PPh Pasal 22 → sistem menetapkan jalur (**hijau** langsung keluar, **kuning** cek dokumen, **merah** periksa fisik; importir bereputasi baik bisa dapat jalur MITA/AEO) → terbit **SPPB**, barang keluar pelabuhan.
segments.tr: - **Import:** file a **PIB** (Import Goods Notification), pay import duty + import VAT (PPN) + Income Tax Article 22 (PPh 22) → the system assigns a lane (**green** goes straight out, **yellow** document check, **red** physical inspection; importers with a good track record may qualify for the MITA/AEO lane) → a **SPPB** is issued and the goods leave the port.

segments.src: Satu detail yang sering mengejutkan: **Bea Cukai menghitung nilai pabean atas dasar CIF**, dikonversi dengan **NDPBM** (kurs pajak yang ditetapkan Kemenkeu tiap minggu).
segments.tr: One detail that often surprises people: **Customs calculates customs value based on CIF**, converted using the **NDPBM** (the tax exchange rate set weekly by the Ministry of Finance).

segments.src: Jadi walaupun kamu membeli dengan term FOB, ongkos angkut dan asuransi tetap ditambahkan ke dasar perhitungan bea masuk.
segments.tr: So even if you buy under FOB terms, freight and insurance are still added to the basis for calculating import duty.

segments.src: **3) Dokumen — "paspor" barang**
segments.tr: **3) Documents — the goods' "passport"**

segments.src: Minimal yang harus ada: **Commercial Invoice** (nilai transaksi), **Packing List** (isi, berat, dimensi), dan dokumen angkut — **Bill of Lading (B/L)** untuk laut atau **Air Waybill (AWB)** untuk udara.
segments.tr: The minimum required: a **Commercial Invoice** (transaction value), a **Packing List** (contents, weight, dimensions), and transport documents — a **Bill of Lading (B/L)** for sea or an **Air Waybill (AWB)** for air.

segments.src: Bedanya penting: B/L bisa diterbitkan "to order" dan **merupakan dokumen kepemilikan** yang bisa dialihkan lewat endorsement; AWB tidak.
segments.tr: The difference matters: a B/L can be issued "to order" and **is a document of title** that can be transferred by endorsement; an AWB cannot.

segments.src: Tambahannya: **SKA/Certificate of Origin** (Form D untuk ASEAN, Form E untuk China) agar bisa menikmati tarif preferensi, polis asuransi, dan izin lartas bila diperlukan.
segments.tr: Additionally: **SKA/Certificate of Origin** (Form D for ASEAN, Form E for China) to qualify for preferential rates, an insurance policy, and lartas permits where required.

segments.src: Kalau satu angka saja tidak cocok antara invoice, packing list, dan B/L, barang tertahan — sementara biaya *demurrage* dan *storage* terus berjalan per hari.
segments.tr: If even one figure doesn't match across the invoice, packing list, and B/L, the goods get held up, while *demurrage* and *storage* charges keep running daily.

segments.src: Rani punya kedai kopi di Bandung dan ingin mengimpor satu mesin espresso dari Italia.
segments.tr: Rani runs a coffee shop in Bandung and wants to import one espresso machine from Italy.

segments.tr: PPN impor 11% x (CIF + BM)                 = Rp 10.221.750

Jadi DDP menang sekitar Rp 6 juta?
segments.tr: So DDP wins by about Rp 6 million?

segments.src: Belum tentu — dan di sinilah pelajarannya.
segments.tr: Not necessarily — and this is where the lesson lies.

segments.src: Kalau kedai Rani sudah **PKP** (Pengusaha Kena Pajak), PPN impor Rp 10,2 juta bisa dikreditkan sebagai pajak masukan, dan PPh 22 Rp 2,3 juta jadi kredit pajak penghasilan.
segments.tr: If Rani's shop is already a **PKP** (Taxable Enterprise), the import VAT of Rp 10.2 million can be credited as input tax, and the PPh 22 of Rp 2.3 million becomes an income tax credit.

segments.src: Beban riilnya turun menjadi sekitar **Rp 99 juta** — kini EXW yang lebih murah.
segments.tr: Her actual cost drops to about **Rp 99 million**, making EXW the cheaper option now.

segments.src: Sebaliknya pada skema DDP, pajak impor dibayar atas nama penjual asing, sehingga sulit dikreditkan oleh Rani dan berubah jadi biaya mati.
segments.tr: Conversely, under DDP, import taxes are paid on behalf of the foreign seller, so they are hard for Rani to credit and become a sunk cost.

segments.src: Ditambah lagi, penjual asing umumnya tak punya identitas kepabeanan Indonesia untuk menjadi importir tercatat, sehingga DDP sering tidak praktis dijalankan di sini.
segments.tr: On top of that, foreign sellers generally don't have Indonesian customs registration to act as the registered importer, so DDP is often impractical here.

segments.src: Karena itu importir Indonesia biasanya memilih **FOB/FCA, CIF, atau DAP** dan mengurus impor atas nama sendiri lewat PPJK.
segments.tr: That's why Indonesian importers usually choose **FOB/FCA, CIF, or DAP** and handle importation in their own name through a PPJK (customs broker).

segments.src: ## Rangkuman 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Incoterms 2020 menetapkan titik serah **biaya** dan **risiko**, bukan cara pembayaran maupun perpindahan hak milik — dan untuk kontainer, FCA lebih tepat daripada FOB.
segments.tr: 1. Incoterms 2020 set the point where **costs** and **risk** transfer, not the payment method or transfer of ownership — and for containers, FCA is more appropriate than FOB.

segments.src: 2. Bea Cukai menilai impor atas dasar **CIF** dengan kurs NDPBM, jadi ongkos angkut dan asuransi tetap masuk hitungan bea masuk meski kamu membeli dengan term FOB.
segments.tr: 2. Customs values imports on a **CIF** basis using the NDPBM rate, so freight and insurance still count toward import duty even when you buy under FOB terms.

segments.src: 3. Bandingkan penawaran sebagai **landed cost** (harga + logistik + bea + pajak yang benar-benar jadi beban), bukan sebagai harga barang.
segments.tr: 3. Compare offers as **landed cost** (price + logistics + duties + taxes that actually become your burden), not as the goods' price.

segments.tr: - **Incoterms 2020** — 11 standard ICC terms that set out the division of costs and the point of risk transfer between seller and buyer.

id-20261014-news-1.title: September 2026 Trade Balance to Be Released Soon by BPS: Why Does the Oil and Gas Deficit Pressurize the Trade Surplus?

segments.src: Setelah neraca perdagangan Indonesia tercatat defisit pada Mei dan Juni 2026, perhatian pelaku pasar, pengamat ekonomi, dan pembuat kebijakan kini tertuju pada rilis data September 2026 dari Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS).
segments.tr: After Indonesia's trade balance recorded a deficit in May and June 2026, the attention of market participants, economic observers, and policymakers is now focused on the September 2026 data release from Statistics Indonesia (BPS).

segments.src: Data ini dipandang sebagai ujian berikutnya: apakah tekanan pada neraca perdagangan bersifat sementara, atau justru menjadi pola yang bertahan.
segments.tr: This data is seen as the next test: whether the pressure on the trade balance is temporary, or rather becomes a persistent pattern.

segments.src: Artikel ini menjelaskan cara membaca selisih ekspor-impor, peran impor minyak dan gas (migas) di tengah harga minyak yang tinggi, serta kaitannya dengan pergerakan nilai tukar rupiah.
segments.tr: This article explains how to read the export-import gap, the role of oil and gas (migas) imports amid high oil prices, and their connection to the rupiah exchange rate movement.

segments.src: Artikel ini bersifat informatif dan bukan merupakan saran investasi.
segments.tr: This article is informative and does not constitute investment advice.

segments.src: ## Apa Itu Neraca Perdagangan?
segments.tr: ## What Is a Trade Balance?

segments.src: Neraca perdagangan adalah selisih antara nilai ekspor dan nilai impor barang dalam suatu periode.
segments.tr: The trade balance is the difference between the value of exports and the value of goods imports over a specific period.

segments.src: Rumusnya sederhana:
segments.tr: The formula is simple:

segments.src: **Neraca perdagangan = nilai ekspor − nilai impor**
segments.tr: **Trade balance = export value − import value**

segments.src: - **Surplus** terjadi ketika nilai ekspor lebih besar daripada impor. Artinya, devisa yang masuk dari penjualan barang ke luar negeri melebihi devisa yang keluar untuk membeli barang dari luar negeri.
segments.tr: - **Surplus** occurs when the value of exports is greater than imports. This means foreign exchange entering from selling goods abroad exceeds foreign exchange going out to buy goods from abroad.

segments.src: - **Defisit** terjadi ketika nilai impor melampaui ekspor. Dalam kondisi ini, kebutuhan valuta asing untuk membayar impor lebih besar daripada pasokan yang datang dari ekspor.
segments.tr: - **Deficit** occurs when the value of imports surpasses exports. In this condition, the foreign currency needed to pay for imports is larger than the supply coming from exports.

segments.src: BPS biasanya membagi data ini menjadi dua kelompok besar: sektor migas dan nonmigas.
segments.tr: BPS usually divides this data into two major groups: the oil and gas (migas) and non-oil and gas sectors.

segments.src: Pemisahan ini penting karena kedua sektor memiliki dinamika yang sangat berbeda.
segments.tr: This separation is important because both sectors have very different dynamics.

segments.src: ## Cara Membaca Data dengan Benar
segments.tr: ## How to Read Data Correctly

segments.src: Satu angka headline saja sering kali belum cukup untuk menarik kesimpulan.
segments.tr: A single headline figure alone is often not enough to draw conclusions.

segments.src: Ada beberapa hal yang perlu diperhatikan saat BPS merilis data.
segments.tr: There are several things to watch out for when BPS releases the data.

segments.src: 1. **Bandingkan dengan bulan sebelumnya (month-to-month).** Perbandingan ini menunjukkan arah terbaru, tetapi dapat dipengaruhi faktor musiman seperti jumlah hari kerja dan hari libur.
segments.tr: 1. **Compare with the previous month (month-to-month).** This comparison shows the latest direction, but can be influenced by seasonal factors such as the number of working days and holidays.

segments.src: 2. **Bandingkan dengan periode yang sama tahun lalu (year-on-year).** Cara ini membantu menyaring pola musiman dan memperlihatkan tren yang lebih jernih.
segments.tr: 2. **Compare with the same period last year (year-on-year).** This method helps filter out seasonal patterns and reveals a clearer trend.

segments.src: 3. **Pisahkan migas dan nonmigas.** Surplus nonmigas yang kuat bisa saja "termakan" oleh defisit migas sehingga neraca keseluruhan menyempit.
segments.tr: 3. **Separate oil and gas from non-oil and gas.** A strong non-oil and gas surplus could be "eaten up" by the oil and gas deficit, causing the overall balance to narrow.

segments.src: 4. **Perhatikan komposisi impor.** Impor bahan baku dan barang modal umumnya mencerminkan aktivitas produksi dan investasi, sedangkan impor barang konsumsi memberi sinyal yang berbeda.
segments.tr: 4. **Pay attention to the import composition.** Raw material and capital goods imports generally reflect production and investment activity, while consumer goods imports signal something different.

segments.src: 5. **Lihat komoditas ekspor utama.** Harga komoditas global, seperti batu bara, minyak sawit, dan produk logam, sangat memengaruhi nilai ekspor Indonesia.
segments.tr: 5. **Look at major export commodities.** Global commodity prices, such as coal, palm oil, and metal products, heavily influence Indonesia's export value.

segments.src: 6. **Cermati ekspektasi pasar.** Reaksi pasar sering kali ditentukan oleh selisih antara angka aktual dan perkiraan para ekonom, bukan angkanya semata.
segments.tr: 6. **Examine market expectations.** Market reaction is often determined by the difference between the actual figure and economists' forecasts, rather than the figure alone.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Migas Menjadi Sorotan?
segments.tr: ## Why Are Oil and Gas in the Spotlight?

segments.src: Indonesia kini merupakan importir neto minyak.
segments.tr: Indonesia is now a net oil importer.

segments.src: Konsumsi bahan bakar dalam negeri, terutama untuk transportasi dan industri, lebih besar daripada produksi minyak mentah domestik.
segments.tr: Domestic fuel consumption, especially for transportation and industry, is greater than domestic crude oil production.

segments.src: Karena itu, Indonesia mengimpor minyak mentah maupun hasil minyak seperti bensin dan solar dalam jumlah besar.
segments.tr: Therefore, Indonesia imports both crude oil and refined products like gasoline and diesel in large quantities.

segments.src: Ketika harga minyak dunia berada di level tinggi, nilai impor migas ikut membengkak meskipun volume impor tidak berubah banyak.
segments.tr: When world oil prices are at high levels, the value of oil and gas imports swells even if import volumes do not change much.

segments.src: Akibatnya, sektor migas cenderung mencatat defisit yang lebih lebar dan mengurangi surplus yang dihasilkan sektor nonmigas.
segments.tr: As a result, the oil and gas sector tends to record a wider deficit and reduce the surplus generated by the non-oil and gas sector.

segments.src: Beberapa faktor yang membuat tekanan migas terasa lebih berat:
segments.tr: Several factors make the oil and gas pressure feel heavier:

segments.src: - **Harga minyak global.** Kenaikan harga langsung mengerek nilai impor dalam dolar AS.
segments.tr: - **Global oil prices.** Price increases directly drive up import values in US dollars.

segments.src: - **Kebutuhan konsumsi domestik.** Permintaan energi relatif kaku sehingga sulit ditekan dalam jangka pendek.
segments.tr: - **Domestic consumption needs.** Energy demand is relatively rigid, making it difficult to suppress in the short term.

segments.src: - **Nilai tukar.** Impor migas dibayar dalam dolar AS. Pelemahan rupiah membuat beban rupiah untuk impor yang sama menjadi lebih besar.
segments.tr: - **Exchange rate.** Oil and gas imports are paid in US dollars. Rupiah depreciation makes the rupiah burden for the same imports larger.

segments.src: - **Produksi dalam negeri.** Produksi minyak yang tidak mampu mengimbangi konsumsi menjaga ketergantungan pada impor.
segments.tr: - **Domestic production.** Oil production that fails to keep pace with consumption maintains dependency on imports.

segments.src: ## Dampaknya bagi Rupiah
segments.tr: ## Impact on the Rupiah

segments.src: Neraca perdagangan merupakan salah satu komponen utama transaksi berjalan, yang pada gilirannya memengaruhi keseimbangan pasokan dan permintaan valuta asing.
segments.tr: The trade balance is one of the main components of the current account, which in turn affects the balance of foreign exchange supply and demand.

segments.src: Secara umum:
segments.tr: In general:

segments.src: - Surplus perdagangan yang kuat cenderung memperbesar pasokan devisa dan menopang stabilitas rupiah.
segments.tr: - A strong trade surplus tends to enlarge foreign exchange supplies and support rupiah stability.

segments.src: - Surplus yang menyempit atau defisit meningkatkan kebutuhan dolar AS untuk membayar impor sehingga dapat menambah tekanan pada rupiah, terutama bila bersamaan dengan keluarnya modal asing.
segments.tr: - A narrowing surplus or deficit increases the need for US dollars to pay for imports, which can add pressure to the rupiah, especially if it coincides with foreign capital outflows.

segments.src: Namun, nilai tukar tidak ditentukan oleh neraca perdagangan semata.
segments.tr: However, the exchange rate is not determined by the trade balance alone.

segments.src: Arah suku bunga bank sentral, kebijakan moneter Amerika Serikat, aliran investasi portofolio, cadangan devisa, dan sentimen global turut berperan.
segments.tr: Central bank interest rate directions, United States monetary policy, portfolio investment flows, foreign exchange reserves, and global sentiment also play a role.

segments.src: Karena itu, satu rilis data tidak otomatis menentukan arah rupiah, tetapi dapat memperkuat atau melemahkan sentimen yang sudah ada.
segments.tr: Therefore, a single data release does not automatically determine the direction of the rupiah, but it can strengthen or weaken existing sentiment.

segments.src: ## Apa yang Perlu Dicermati dari Rilis September?
segments.tr: ## What to Watch from the September Release?

segments.src: Ada beberapa pertanyaan kunci yang akan membantu menilai data September 2026:
segments.tr: There are several key questions that will help assess the September 2026 data:

segments.src: - Apakah neraca perdagangan kembali ke zona surplus, atau defisit berlanjut?
segments.tr: - Will the trade balance return to surplus territory, or will the deficit continue?

segments.src: - Seberapa besar defisit migas dibandingkan bulan-bulan sebelumnya?
segments.tr: - How large is the oil and gas deficit compared to previous months?

segments.src: - Apakah surplus nonmigas mampu menutup tekanan dari impor energi?
segments.tr: - Is the non-oil and gas surplus able to cover the pressure from energy imports?

segments.src: - Bagaimana kinerja ekspor komoditas unggulan dan permintaan dari mitra dagang utama?
segments.tr: - How is the performance of flagship commodity exports and demand from major trading partners?

segments.src: - Apakah impor bahan baku dan barang modal menunjukkan perlambatan atau justru penguatan aktivitas industri?
segments.tr: - Do raw material and capital goods imports show a slowdown or instead strengthen industrial activity?

segments.src: Jawaban atas pertanyaan tersebut akan memberi gambaran lebih utuh dibandingkan satu angka surplus atau defisit.
segments.tr: Answers to these questions will provide a more complete picture than a single surplus or deficit figure.

segments.src: ## Upaya Mengurangi Tekanan Impor Migas
segments.tr: ## Efforts to Reduce Oil and Gas Import Pressure

segments.src: Pemerintah dan pelaku industri telah lama membahas sejumlah langkah untuk menekan ketergantungan pada impor energi, antara lain:
segments.tr: The government and industry players have long discussed a number of steps to suppress reliance on energy imports, among others:

segments.src: - meningkatkan produksi dan eksplorasi minyak dan gas dalam negeri,
segments.tr: - increasing domestic oil and gas production and exploration,

segments.src: - mendorong penggunaan biofuel dan energi baru terbarukan,
segments.tr: - encouraging the use of biofuels and new renewable energy,

segments.src: - mempercepat adopsi kendaraan listrik dan efisiensi energi,
segments.tr: - accelerating the adoption of electric vehicles and energy efficiency,

segments.src: - memperkuat hilirisasi dan diversifikasi ekspor nonmigas.
segments.tr: - strengthening downstream processing and non-oil and gas export diversification.

segments.src: Hasil dari langkah-langkah ini umumnya baru terasa dalam jangka menengah hingga panjang, sehingga dalam jangka pendek neraca perdagangan tetap sensitif terhadap pergerakan harga minyak dunia.
segments.tr: The results of these steps generally take effect only in the medium to long term, so in the short term, the trade balance remains sensitive to world oil price movements.

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Rilis neraca perdagangan September 2026 akan menjadi penanda penting setelah dua bulan defisit pada Mei dan Juni.
segments.tr: The release of the September 2026 trade balance will be an important marker after two months of deficits in May and June.

segments.src: Kuncinya bukan sekadar apakah hasilnya surplus atau defisit, tetapi bagaimana komposisinya: seberapa besar beban migas, seberapa kuat ekspor nonmigas, dan bagaimana impor mencerminkan kondisi ekonomi domestik.
segments.tr: The key is not merely whether the result is a surplus or a deficit, but how the composition looks: how heavy the oil and gas burden is, how strong non-oil and gas exports are, and how imports reflect domestic economic conditions.

segments.src: Membaca data secara menyeluruh akan membantu publik memahami risikonya tanpa terjebak pada satu angka tunggal.
segments.tr: Reading the data comprehensively will help the public understand the risks without getting trapped in a single number.
